<think>**Evaluating shared add-subtract design**

**Refining prefix carry design**

**Packing prefix arrays**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(WIDTH);

    wire sub_a = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire sub_b = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire subtract = sub_a | sub_b;
    wire arithmetic_enable = ~Oper[2] & ~(Oper[1] & Oper[0]);
    wire or_enable   = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire and_enable  = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire xor_enable  = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire xnor_enable = (Oper == 3'b110);

    wire [WIDTH-1:0] x = a ^ {WIDTH{sub_a}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] y = b ^ {WIDTH{sub_b}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] propagate [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] generate_carry [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH:0] carry;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_result;

    assign propagate[0] = x ^ y;
    assign generate_carry[0] = x & y;

    genvar level, bit_index;
    generate
        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin : prefix_level
            for (bit_index = 0; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin : prefix_bit
                if (bit_index >= (1 << level)) begin : combine
                    assign generate_carry[level+1][bit_index] =
                        generate_carry[level][bit_index] |
                        (propagate[level][bit_index] &
                         generate_carry[level][bit_index-(1 << level)]);
                    assign propagate[level+1][bit_index] =
                        propagate[level][bit_index] &
                        propagate[level][bit_index-(1 << level)];
                end else begin : forward
                    assign generate_carry[level+1][bit_index] =
                        generate_carry[level][bit_index];
                    assign propagate[level+1][bit_index] =
                        propagate[level][bit_index];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign carry[0] = subtract;
    generate
        for (bit_index = 0; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin : result_bit
            assign carry[bit_index+1] = generate_carry[LEVELS][bit_index] |
                (propagate[LEVELS][bit_index] & subtract);
            assign arithmetic_result[bit_index] = propagate[0][bit_index] ^ carry[bit_index];
        end
    endgenerate

    always @* begin
        sum = (arithmetic_result & {WIDTH{arithmetic_enable}}) |
              ((a | b)  & {WIDTH{or_enable}}) |
              ((a & b)  & {WIDTH{and_enable}}) |
              ((a ^ b)  & {WIDTH{xor_enable}}) |
              ((a ~^ b) & {WIDTH{xnor_enable}});
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The arithmetic paths combine carry propagation with operation selection. Separate addition and subtraction expressions can also duplicate arithmetic hardware and increase output-selection loading.",
  "rewrite": "Share one arithmetic datapath across all three arithmetic operations. Complement b for a-b, complement a for b-a, and inject carry-in one for either subtraction. Compute carries with a logarithmic parallel-prefix network, followed by one-hot masked output selection.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "At WIDTH=32 the carry network has five prefix levels rather than a linear carry chain. This targets reduced worst-case arithmetic arrival time; the actual gain depends on technology mapping, buffering, and interface loading and has not been measured here.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The prefix network adds intermediate carry-combine logic and wiring, while sharing the three arithmetic operations removes duplicated datapaths. The design targets the stated area cap, but mapped area, timing, and electrical compliance require evaluation with the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module interface, unsigned ports, WIDTH parameter and default WIDTH=64. Arithmetic is truncated to WIDTH bits. Operations 000 through 110 retain their specified meanings, and 111 returns zero. The implementation is combinational with no state or added latency. The reference contains no CRC ports or CRC state."
}
